name: seller.draft.createComplete
title: Profile: seller.draft.createComplete
description: Canonical profile for creating a seller draft in one complete call.
text:
# seller.draft.createComplete

TL;DR:
- Use this when most draft fields are already known.
- Preserve the returned draft id even when the draft is already complete.

This profile is for one-shot draft preparation.
whenToUse: The seller already knows title, price, category, location, and other core fields.
Upload ids are already available or can be attached immediately.
recommended: Include all known fields in the create call.
Preserve draft.id for later patch, gallery, or publish actions.
avoid: Do not drop the returned draft id.
Do not assume a draft is publish-ready unless required publish fields are actually filled.
exampleInterpretation: The response returns the canonical draft state.
draft.id must be stored for the rest of the flow.
